name: Historic Centre of Salvador de Bahia
description: Salvador's old town, known as the Pelourinho, climbs a hillside above the bay in northeastern Brazil. It was the colony's first capital, and its cobbled lanes are lined with brightly painted colonial houses and richly decorated churches from the 17th to 19th centuries. It also holds the memory of the New World's first slave market, and Afro-Brazilian music, food and religion remain central to its life.
